integrity: The universal claim is established analytically by invertible diagonal-filter reduction to a unital channel together with an independent singlet PPT calculation. Numerical searches were used only for exploration and not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the tensor square of one qubit generalized amplitude-damping channel with identical parameters. It does not characterize asymmetric channel pairs, higher local dimensions, or multipartite entanglement annihilation.
title: Exact entanglement-annihilation threshold for identical generalized amplitude-damping channels
